text:
Posting for another member that wishes to remain anonymous
We had my first A5 interview a few days before the war broke out. 

We received a decision on the same day that they are granting me the A5 visa conditional on a 30,000 ILS deposit and gave us a 45 calendar day window to appeal. 

We submitted the appeal a week later, but due to the war, visa offices have remained closed. Today is the last calendar day of the appeal window. 

Has anyone been in or know of similar cases? We want to understand if the appeal window still applies during the outbreak of war, or the timer is "paused" while the war was ongoing, given that visa offices were not operational during that time?

What are our options here? We have reached out to PIBA multiple times via email and they have failed to respond to us on the status of the appeal or relevance of the appeal window under war circumstances.
